core_obligations: Define kappa as an upper bound of three cardinals (proof lines 11312-11316): the sizes |coprod_V j_{U!}O_U(V)| over all objects U, the cardinals kappa(O(V) -> O(U)) supplied by the More on Algebra enlarging lemma for all morphisms U -> V, and the cardinal of lemma-qis-small.

Reduce the lemma to the claim that any subcomplex S of a complex F representing an object of QC(O) with |S| <= kappa sits in a subcomplex H of size <= kappa which still represents an object of QC(O) (proof lines 11317-11323).

Deduce part (1) from the claim (proof lines 11325-11336): a nonzero section s of H^i(F) over U gives a nonzero map j_{U!}O_U[-i] -> F whose image is a subcomplex of size <= kappa, so the claim produces a nonzero object of QC(O) of size <= kappa mapping to K.

Deduce part (2) from the claim (proof lines 11338-11350): represent E by a complex E^bullet of size <= kappa using lemma-qis-small and the choice of kappa, and apply the claim in each degree n to obtain subcomplexes E_n^bullet of the K_n^bullet containing the image of a_n, of size <= kappa.

Prove the claim by an induction (proof lines 11352-11429, closed at 11453): build S_0 subset S_1 subset ... of size <= kappa whose conditions (1) and (2) force the derived-tensor comparison of the union H = union S_n to be an isomorphism on all cohomology, using the enlarging lemma for each morphism U -> V to choose the subcomplexes N_f, M_f, and then lemma-build-from to add the required subsets; filtered colimits commute with derived tensor product and cohomology, so H represents an object of QC(O).
proof_roadmap: Pick kappa as a bound on the sizes of the objects j_{U!}O_U, the enlarging cardinals of the ring maps O(V) -> O(U) and the cardinal of the quasi-isomorphism-size lemma.

Prove the claim: inductively enlarge a small subcomplex S to S_{n+1} so that the two exactness conditions hold for every morphism U -> V, using the enlarging lemma to find N_f and M_f and lemma-build-from to realise the union of the chosen subsets, keeping the size <= kappa.
Read parts (1) and (2) off the claim by representing K (resp. E) by a complex of size <= kappa and applying the claim degreewise.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a single cardinal kappa controlling two approximation properties in the quasi-coherent category QC(O) of a ringed site: every nonzero object receives a nonzero map from an object of size <= kappa, and every map out of a small object into a direct sum factors through small summands (statement lines 11295-11309). Its non-formal content is the inductive claim (proof lines 11352-11429): one enlarges a subcomplex S_n inside a fixed representative F to S_{n+1} so that the kernel and image conditions hold for every morphism U -> V, choosing the required pieces by the More on Algebra enlarging lemma and realising them jointly by lemma-build-from, all while keeping size <= kappa, and then takes the union and uses that filtered colimits commute with the derived tensor product and cohomology. H2: one careful transfinite-free induction with two constructions, fully written out.
